name: silvershop/conversion-tracking
description: Ad conversion / event tracking core for SilverShop (CMS 6): a normalised ViewContent→AddToCart→InitiateCheckout→Purchase event model, an always-on GA4-shaped dataLayer emit, hard consent gating bound to silvershop/cookieconsent, deterministic purchase event_id dedup, and a queued server-side dispatch framework. Per-platform connectors (Meta, Google) plug in through the ConversionProvider seam.

suggest.silvershop/catalog-data: Shared product-identity source: content_ids / item_id = CatalogProductData::feedId(), so the ad-platform catalogue match lines up with the product feed by construction. A built-in identical-rule fallback is used when absent.
suggest.silvershop/cookieconsent: The consent gate + Consent Mode v2 source every tag/event binds to (Meta → marketing, GA4 → statistics, Ads → marketing). Strongly recommended; without it the module default-denies.
suggest.silvershop/order-confirmation: Provides the unified, status-aware checkout/complete/{ID} success render the client-side Purchase fires on (paid only, never pending).
